name: wraith
description: Wraith (red team) + Aegis (blue team) — two independent, self-contained cybersecurity agents for pi. Each ships an offensive/defensive persona, team-specific tools, and the 817-skill offline workflow library (Nmap, Burp, sqlmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Sliver, Volatility, Sigma, YARA, Splunk, ...). Built for Kali Linux.
